## 1. Current Dockerfile Structure

**File:** `cmd-adaptor-sns/Dockerfile`
**Owner:** RepoSync (DO NOT EDIT LOCALLY)

```dockerfile
FROM amazoncorretto:17

COPY ./target/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar /local
COPY ./target/dependencies/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar /local/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar

WORKDIR /tmp

RUN yum install -y shadow-utils unzip \
    && yum update -y ca-certificates cpio curl cyrus-sasl-lib expat glib2 \
       libcurl libdb libssh2 libdb-utils libnghttp2 libpng libtasn1 libxml2 \
       ncurses ncurses-base ncurses-libs nss nss-util nss-softokn nspr \
       openldap openssl-libs python python-libs sqlite xz-libs yum zlib \
    && yum erase -y vim-data \
    && yum clean all \
    && rm -rf /var/cache/yum \
    && curl --silent --output /tmp/envconsul.zip \
       https://releases.hashicorp.com/envconsul/0.13.1/envconsul_0.13.1_linux_amd64.zip \
    && unzip envconsul.zip \
    && rm -f envconsul.zip \
    && mv envconsul /usr/local/bin/envconsul \
    && chown root:root /usr/local/bin/envconsul \
    && chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/envconsul \
    && adduser -u 1000 -U -m -s /bin/bash fdpuser \
    && chmod 0755 /local/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar \
    && chown fdpuser:fdpuser /local/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar \
    && chmod 0755 /local/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar \
    && chown fdpuser:fdpuser /local/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar

WORKDIR /home/fdpuser
USER fdpuser

CMD ["java", "-agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=*:8077",
     "-javaagent:/local/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar",
     "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote", "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.port=9012",
     "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.rmi.port=9012",
     "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false",
     "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.local.only=false",
     "-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.ssl=false",
     "-Djava.rmi.server.hostname=localhost",
     "-jar", "/local/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar"]
```

## 2. Layer Analysis

| # | Instruction | What it does | Estimated Size | Cache-safe? |
|---|-------------|-------------|---------------|:-----------:|
| 1 | `FROM amazoncorretto:17` | Base image (full JDK + Amazon Linux 2) | ~450 MB | ✅ (pinned tag) |
| 2 | `COPY ./target/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar` | Application JAR | ~40-60 MB | ❌ (changes every build) |
| 3 | `COPY ./target/dependencies/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar` | OTel Java agent | ~15-20 MB | ✅ (changes rarely) |
| 4 | `RUN yum install + update + curl envconsul + adduser` | System packages + envconsul + user | ~30-50 MB | ❌ (after COPY) |
| — | **Total** | | **~535-580 MB** | |

## 3. Cache-Invalidation Risks

### Critical Issue: COPY Before RUN

```dockerfile
COPY ./target/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar /local          # ← Changes every build
COPY ./target/dependencies/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar  # ← Changes rarely
RUN yum install ... && curl envconsul ...               # ← Expensive, ~60-120s
```

**Problem:** The application JAR changes on every build. Because `COPY` comes before `RUN`, the expensive `yum install + envconsul download` layer is **invalidated and rebuilt every single time**.

**Fix:** Move `RUN` (system deps) before `COPY` (application JARs). System deps rarely change; application code changes every build.

### Other Cache Issues

| Issue | Impact | Fix |
|-------|--------|-----|
| `yum update -y [packages]` | Non-deterministic — different output on different days | Pin base image digest; or remove `yum update` and use a regularly-rebuilt base |
| Monolithic RUN | Any change to any part rebuilds the entire layer | Split into logical layers (deps, binary download, user creation) |
| No `.dockerignore` | Unnecessary files in build context can trigger cache misses | Add `.dockerignore` |
| Unpinned base image tag | `amazoncorretto:17` resolves to different digests over time | Pin to specific version or digest |

---

## 4. Security Observations

| Finding | Severity | Recommendation |
|---------|----------|----------------|
| Full JDK in runtime image | Medium | Switch to JRE-only (remove compiler, dev tools from attack surface) |
| `yum update` in build | Low | Reduces known CVEs but makes builds non-reproducible |
| Debug agent enabled (`-agentlib:jdwp`) | **High** | Remote debug port open in production images — should be disabled or profile-controlled |
| JMX remote enabled (unauthenticated) | **High** | `-Dcom.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticate=false` — no auth on JMX port |
| envconsul downloaded over HTTPS (no checksum) | Medium | Add SHA256 checksum verification |
| Non-root user ✅ | Good | `USER fdpuser` at the end |
| No HEALTHCHECK | Low | Add for orchestrator readiness detection |

## 5. Build Context Analysis

### Current Context: `cmd-adaptor-sns/`

The docker-compose.yml defines `build: ../../../../../cmd-adaptor-sns` for the `command-adaptor` service. In CI, the build is triggered via `docker-compose up --build command-adaptor`, making `cmd-adaptor-sns/` the effective build context.

| Path | Size (est.) | Needed? |
|------|-------------|:-------:|
| `target/cmd-adaptor-sns-exec.jar` | ~40-60 MB | ✅ |
| `target/dependencies/opentelemetry-javaagent.jar` | ~15-20 MB | ✅ |
| `target/` (rest — classes, reports, etc.) | ~30-50 MB | ❌ |
| `src/main/java/` | ~5-10 MB | ❌ |
| `src/main/resources/` | ~1 MB | ❌ |
| `pom.xml` | <1 KB | ❌ |
| `.idea/`, `*.iml` | Variable | ❌ |
| **Total sent** | **~100-150 MB** | |
| **Actually needed** | **~55-80 MB** | |

## 6. Prioritised Optimisation Opportunities

| # | Change | Impact | Effort | Risk | Owner |
|---|--------|--------|--------|------|-------|
| 1 | **Reorder: RUN before COPY** | Eliminates 60-120s rebuild of system deps on every build | Very Low | None | RepoSync MR |
| 2 | **Switch base to JRE-only Alpine** | Image: ~550MB → ~180MB (67% reduction) | Low | Test runtime compatibility | RepoSync MR |
| 3 | **Add `.dockerignore`** | Context: ~150MB → ~80MB (50% reduction) | Very Low | None | RepoSync MR (or local) |
| 4 | **Split monolithic RUN** | Better cache reuse (envconsul layer cached separately) | Low | None | RepoSync MR |
| 5 | **Remove debug/JMX from default CMD** | Security hardening | Low | Need env-specific entrypoint | RepoSync MR |
| 6 | **Pin base image digest** | Reproducible builds | Low | Must update digest on patch | RepoSync MR |
| 7 | **Add HEALTHCHECK** | Faster readiness detection in orchestrators | Very Low | None | RepoSync MR |
| 8 | **Multi-stage build** | Clean separation; build tools not in runtime image | Medium | Dockerfile restructure | RepoSync MR |
| 9 | **Remove envconsul (if unused)** | -15MB, simpler image | Low | Confirm runtime usage first | RepoSync MR |
| 10 | **Cache mounts for local builds** | Faster repeated local builds | Low | BuildKit required | RepoSync MR |

### Recommended Priority Order

**Quick wins (do first):** #1 (reorder), #3 (.dockerignore), #7 (healthcheck)
**Medium effort, high impact:** #2 (JRE Alpine), #4 (split RUN)
**Security:** #5 (debug/JMX), #6 (pin digest)
**Larger restructure:** #8 (multi-stage)
